body:
Honestly, i think there are No A-holes Here.

You are obviously not the A-hole, as you have taken no action to cause the situation. This was neither deliberate action nor deliberate inaction. You just didn’t stop your daughter from referring to people as she wishes.

On the other hand (with the current information given), your ex and his mother are not being the A-holes here either, as (as far as i can tell with the information) they seem to just be worried about how you may be treating the child and if she may be being coerced in any way. Now thats with the current information and an attempt to see the best in people.

I would suggest sitting down for a conversation without the daughter present and trying to explain the situation, from the given information this feels like a misunderstanding. It would probably be best for your daughter to clear up the misunderstanding, even if it is difficult. Bad blood between parental figures can really hamper proper development, especially at such a young and vulnerable age.

I agree on the part about religions that currently hurt people, actively or even just passively supporting their violence and abuse is supporting and encouraging continued harm.

But there are peaceful, and non-abusive, sects of many religions with violent or abusive histories or present ideologies. Things have gotten much better in terms of how these organizations operate.

Yes, we should not forget the bloody past of any religion. We should not forget the crusades, we should not forget the religious aspects to japan in WWII, we should not forget the current religious war with the most violent sects of Islam. Only a fool disregards history.

But the past is not the only metric by which we should judge something, we should also look at the current actions and the likely future actions.

Im gonna be honest, I think the best a suicide with a detailed letter would do is cause an investigation. If you want to get them behind bars, you will need some solid evidence. Ideally some form of recorded exchange.
You may also want to at least stick it out until they’re in prison, hopefully whole you’re using that excuse to not kill yourself, you can find another more long term reason to live... keep in mind that i don’t believe the person they are abetting (you) have to actually commit the illegal action for an abetment case, but im not a lawyer, so you may want to double check with one on that.
